baseline.title: One concern per PR rule violated: 57 files, ~6 groups in single PR
baseline.description: CLAUDE.md states 'one concern per PR' and tasks.md:3 references this rule. Baseline flagged the same issue. Warrants rule amendment or exception note.

candidate.title: Branch bundles ~6 concerns, violating one-concern-per-PR
candidate.description: Branch lands OpenSpec plan, plugin surface (commands + 8 agents + skill), Stage-1 detectors, parity eval harness, vendored upstream recipe, D10 architecture split, and two published eval runs as one change. Should split into stacked PRs along commit boundaries and restack with `git rebase --onto` as each parent merges.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Report-only not structurally enforced: Bash patterns permit writes
missed_P0_regressions.description: allowed-tools pre-approves Bash(git diff:*) and Bash(rg:*), both of which can create/overwrite files. git diff --output=<file> redirects output to arbitrary paths; ripgrep --pre executes arbitrary programs. Contradicts spec.md:49-51, design.md:72, and command docs claiming all pre-approved tools are read-only.

missed_P0_regressions.title: candidate.sh report-only assertion misses file modifications
missed_P0_regressions.description: git status --porcelain alone doesn't catch: committed changes (tree reads clean), git checkout/reset, writes to .gitignored paths, or writes outside $WD (~/.claude/, /tmp). Future runs that commit or write externally will pass the invariant check falsely.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Schema example contradicts rule for confidence field
missed_P0_regressions.description: Example object shows 'confidence': 100, but rule at line 36 states finders leave it at 0. Finders copying the example emit 100.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Baseline grep pattern too narrow, silently accepts output mismatches
missed_P0_regressions.description: Loud-failure cross-check greps only 'found [1-9][0-9]* issue'; patterns like '3 findings', 'Issues found: 3', or refusals pass silently as empty baseline. Systematically misses baseline extraction failures.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Prompt injection via untrusted review text in extract and match scripts
missed_P0_regressions.description: extract.sh:14 and match.sh:17-19 interpolate untrusted review text; reviso-finder-prior-reviews ingests PR comments. Bounded by read-only tooling but vulnerable if tool restrictions weakened (see finding 1).

missed_P0_regressions.title: PR description: unit-tested with mocks claim unsupported
missed_P0_regressions.description: PR claims 'Majority + judge logic unit-tested with mocks' but no test files, fixtures, or mock harnesses appear in the 57 changed files.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Run provenance not recorded: reuses v0 baseline without tracking
missed_P0_regressions.description: No baseline.json in run dir. judge.sh reused v0 baseline but nothing records baseline_ref field for self-description.

claimed_wins_unverified.title: /reviso:review hard-pins model: opus, contradicting its own spec
claimed_wins_unverified.description: Spec requires the single-pass review to run on the session's model for parity and cost comparison, but the command hard-pins `model: opus`. Users on Sonnet sessions silently get Opus, making per-run cost several times higher than the /review baseline it is benchmarked against.

claimed_wins_unverified.title: Harness docs still call commands/review.md the subagent orchestrator
claimed_wins_unverified.description: SKILL.md and CONTRIBUTING.md predate the D10 split and were not updated. They incorrectly state that commands/review.md is the orchestrator and agents/ are driven by /reviso:review, but /reviso:review now has no subagents; agents/ is driven solely by /reviso:audit. Contributors following these docs will make changes that have no effect.

claimed_wins_unverified.title: [ -f ] guard silently truncates the untracked-file scan
claimed_wins_unverified.description: Under `set -eu`, the `[ -f "$f" ]` test is the last command in the loop body; when it fails the entire `while` subshell exits, skipping remaining untracked files with exit status 0 and no message. Occurs with nested untracked git repos, broken symlinks, or non-ASCII paths. A conflict marker in a later untracked file could go unflagged.

claimed_wins_unverified.title: Parity numbers published while the matcher calibration gate is explicitly unrun
claimed_wins_unverified.description: Parity numbers (12% and 25%) are published as measured results while eval/calibration/README.md and eval/README.md both state the matcher "is not trusted until it agrees with hand labels (task 5.5)" and calibration's results show the gate unchecked. Since parity is entirely a function of the uncalibrated matcher, readers take untrusted numbers.
